Under realistic costs (commission_per_trade=$2.0, commission_per_share=$0.003, slippage_cents=$2.0), lookback 3/5/10 momentum maintains positive returns (~5.5-5.6% total) with minimal cost impact (~-0.3% to -0.34%). All 3 lookbacks remain positive under both zero-cost and realistic-cost scenarios, confirming cost robustness.
